scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Individual Artisans
other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in a traditional craft or trade using hand tools, equipment, or small machines
Applicant must be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers
Applicant must be an Indian citizen who has been a permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years
For work sheds, the industrial cooperative society representing eligible artisans must own a piece of land where sheds can be constructed or machines installed
benefits_summary: One‑time grant of up to ₹15,000 for purchase and repair of tool kits/equipment.
